0022600090.text: Both the Indiana Pacers and New Orleans Pelicans are opening their 2026-27 seasons in this regular-season game, which is the Pacers' first of the year and is being played on the road. Indiana is without Aaron Nesmith (out with a hamstring strain), Johnny Furphy (out with a knee injury that required surgery), and T.J. McConnell (out with a hamstring injury). The teams split their two meetings in 2025-26, and the most recent was a 127-119 Pacers win in Indianapolis on January 16, 2026.
